body:
Thanks!

I have also been experiencing this issue of projects starting out as "unsaved" when initially opening them for some time. I just tested this PR with a couple of my projects, and unfortunately, it doesn't seem to fix the issue in my case :-(

However, when trying with a new blank project, it does fix it! When using `master` on a blank project, it starts unsaved. But when I open the same project with this PR, it doesn't.

So, this appears to fix one instance of this problem, but not all of them
